thesis: The episode argues that while technology has historically augmented physical labor, the current shift represents a unique transformation where capital buys code to replace or augment white-collar labor, unlocking multi-trillion-dollar markets beyond the existing enterprise software sector. The discussion traces the evolution from early database systems to cloud-based solutions to explain how this new era fundamentally differs from previous technological shifts by targeting the labor market itself.
